svg.title: Text2Task - Dependency Explorer
svg.text: Entity/relation extraction is pre-written for this scenario. Reconciliation, review, history and the graph are the real code paths.
No edge between “Review the slides” and the rest: message order alone never creates a dependency.
✓ No date used to infer this edge
Removing keeps the edge as “held”, with who/why,
Step 3 of 5 · graph shows the state at this step
Empty graph shows “No confirmed dependencies yet”
